messages:
Ivy R.: quick sync — cross-cloud catalog go-live checklist. Were aiming for a phased launch: marketplace listing + partner badge on Mon Jun 24, SI integration announcements in week 2. Need owners for: press embargo owner, joint blog + partner quote, landing hero + 3 CTA variants, screenshots & short demo videos, localization (EN/FR/DE), and post-launch telemetry dashboard.

Marco D.: I can take the blog + partner quote. Ask partner for a 1-2 sentence quote by Tue EOD. Will draft two blog angles: engineering-focused and customer-impact. Prefer engineering first for initial publish.

Sangeeta P.: landing hero + CTAs here. Draft hero: "Run Redwood inference on EdgeCloud and private stacks". CTAs: `Try in your cloud`, `Request enterprise demo`, `See benchmarks`. Will add concise variants for dev docs and EU locale.

Noah W.: staging infra note: deploy-bot, provision a staging tenant with sample dataset and token-limited keys for the SI dry run. Need predictable latency numbers for listing.\
deploy-bot: Staging tenant created: rwd-edgecloud-catalog-stg-0624. Creds sent to Noah W., Ivy R., Marco D. (expires 72h).

Ivy R.: press embargo: partner prefers Mon 23:59 PT if legal signs off. If legal misses signoff, fallback = staged publish without partner quote + partner follow-up post. We also need an embargo contact list (press + partner PR).

Marco D.: noted. I'll draft the partner email and add a placeholder for the quote. Also will prepare the blog draft in Google Docs and link here once ready.

Sangeeta P.: screenshot checklist: hero banner, latency plot (5-run avg), demo transcript snippet, and partner badge. Avoid customer PII; blur any tenant ids.

Noah W.: sample prompt set for screenshots: `summarize_release_notes`, `faq_answer`, `semantic_search_sample`. Example script:

```
# screenshot run for recording
curl -s -X POST https://staging.redwood.com/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $STG_KEY' \
  -d '{"model":"rw-accelerate","input":"Summarize the EdgeCloud marketplace listing in two sentences"}'
```

Ivy R.: localization: EU team wants variants for FR/DE and an EU-focused CTA: `Request EU demo`. Sangeeta, can you produce localized CTAs by Thu?

Sangeeta P.: will do. Also propose we surface region-specific latency numbers for EU vs US on the listing to avoid confusion.

Marco D.: legal note: partner legal needs to approve co-branded assets and the quote by Fri 12:00 PT. If partner legal blocks images, fallback = use generic diagrams + callouts.

Ivy R.: dry-run scheduling: Thu 18:00 PT (preferred) or Fri 09:00 PT. Dry run must include partner SI tech lead, partner comms, and a rep from legal.

Noah W.: I can make Thu 18:00 PT. Will attach a teardown job to revoke staging creds 48h after creation. Also will capture latency run scripts and publish numbers into the runbook.

deploy-bot: Calendar invite scheduled: EdgeCloud catalog dry run on 2024-06-20T01:00:00Z (Thu 18:00 PT).

Marco D.: blog publishing plan: publish engineering blog at launch + partner spotlight a week later w/ SI quotes and deeper integration details. Comms team wants a short announcement blurb for social.

Sangeeta P.: landing microcopy question: should the badge say "Verified on EdgeCloud" or "EdgeCloud Verified"? Partner prefers the shorter phrase. Thoughts?

Ivy R.: go with partner preference "EdgeCloud Verified" but send final mock to partner ops and legal for sign-off.

Noah W.: perf numbers: will run 10 warmup runs and 5 measured runs for each model variant (rw-accelerate, rw-base-v2, embeddings-lite). Will post avg latency and 95th pct to the runbook.

Marco D.: communications fallback: if partner quote or badge approval misses the window, we hold the co-branded press and publish a Redwood-only launch with a follow-up joint announcement. Documented in runbook.

Ivy R.: owners recap -> Press & embargo: Ivy R.; Blog & partner quote: Marco D.; Landing hero + localization: Sangeeta P.; Staging infra & metrics: Noah W.; Legal & partner ops: Ivy R. We'll reconvene after the dry run to close any remaining blockers. Ping here if you need to swap.

Sangeeta P.: uploading localized CTA variants and hero mockups to Drive now.

Marco D.: will post the blog draft link in this thread by Tue morning.

Noah W.: tagging infra: leaving API keys masked in screenshots and storing raw recordings in restricted S3. See you at dry run. :rocket:
